7.description: [Pending restart] Damage done by Fire Watch proc increased by 30% in pvp combat. This is done to reflect on previous changes made to Fire Watch proc damage and its change to RANGED scaling. We will monitor this change closely.
[Fire Watch] Fixed an issue where Fire Watch damage proc was magic damage, not ranged damage. This made it not scale form your ranged crit modifiers and chance. It is now correctly set as a RANGED.

1.description: With the removal of talent point requirement for these spells, it became mandatory to stack as many of them as possible to feel poweful. This meant that more flavourful abilities were pushed aside. This change aims to reduce the base power of the spells while providing investment paths to empower them.
[Pending Restart][Power Infusion] Reduced duration of Power Infusion to 12 seconds. Down from 15 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Elemental Mastery] Reduced the spell haste given by Elemental Mastery to 10%. Down from 15%.
[Pending Restart][Icy Veins] Reduced duration of Icy veins to 12 seconds. Down from 20 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Shamanism] Shamanism talent now has a Capstone Bonus: Increases the amount of spell haste given by your Elemental Mastery by additional 5%.
[Pending Restart][Shatter] Shatter talent now also increases duration of your Icy Veins by 3/6/9 seconds.
Priest Class: Shadow Word: Pain now deals 10% reduced damage versus players.
Priest Class: Shadow Word: Pain now deals 10% reduced damage versus players.
[Pending Restart] [Thrall and A52] Shred now has a charge system with 3 max charges, charges have a 10 sec cd. Shred now hits up to 3 targets, and can be used from any direction.

[Pending Restart] [Thrall and A52] Capstone for Shredding Attacks has been enabled. - Capstone Bonus: Using Shred while you are behind a target applies Shredded Defense to the enemy, increasing the Physical damage the target takes from you by 5% for 6 seconds, stacking up to 3 times.
[Pending Restart] [Thrall and A52] Ravage and Pounce are now useable during Shadow Dance.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where the Chaos Bolt (Wild Felfire) spell from the Wild Felfire Legendary Mystic Enchantment was in the general spellbook tab instead of the Warlock spellbook tab.
[Pending Restart][Enduring Winter] Enduring Winter talent now has a capstone: With the final rank of this talent, damage of your Water Elemental gets increased by 30%.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] Increased damage of Frost Bomb against creatures by 15%.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] Final explosion of Frost Bomb now also decreases the cooldown of your Water Elemental by 3 seconds per target hit.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] Frozen Waters can now be also triggered by Ice Barrier and Lesser Ice Barrier.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] In addition to Frostbolt, Cone of Cold can now also trigger the wave of freezing ice when hitting target afflicted by your Frost Bomb.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] Increased duration of Frozen Waters, the buff your Water Elemental gets, to 15 seconds. Up from 10.
[Pending Restart][Frost Bomb] Increased duration of Frozen Haste to 14 seconds. Up from 10.
[Pending Restart][Dark Ranger] Reduced weapon damage scaling of Blood Arrow to 70%. Down from 80%.
[Pending Restart][Dark Ranger] Reduced damage and scaling of Blood Arrow DoT by 10%.
[Pending Restart][Lucifur] Added Mangle (Cat) to work with this Legendary Mystic Enchant. It will now be able to proc Devil's Claw damage and Mark of the Beast.

[Pending Restart][Burning Darkness] Burning Darkness was slightly reworked, now it reads: Increases the duration of your Shadowflame ability by 6 seconds and Pyroclasm by 5 seconds. While Pyroclasm is active your Shadow Bolt deals 20% increased damage. In addition, your critical hits from Corruption and Unstable Affliction generate stack of Shadow Born and Flame Born.
[Pending Restart][Elemental Destruction] - Increased damage of Elemental Destruction buff to 14% per stack. Up from 10%.
[Pending Restart][Elemental Destruction] - Increased damage of Energy bolt and Energy Bolt (Lightning Overload) to reflect this change
[Pending Restart][Elemental Destruction] - Changed the damage type of Energy Bolt to Nature damage. It was Firestorm (Nature + Fire) previously.
[Pending Restart][Fire Watch] reduced the damage and scaling of Fire Watch proc by 30.
[Pending Restart][Blood Venom] Hemorrhage now gets 30% damage increase from Bloody Strikes. Down from 50%.
[Pending Restart][Perforation] Rend now increases duration of your Garrote by 1 second per tick. Down from 1.5 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Blood for The Blood God] Reduced Razzashi Talon damage increase per bleed on target to 4%. Down from 5%.
[Pending Restart][Wild Felfire]The triggered area of effect damage from Wild Felfire now deals Chaos damage, from Fire damage.
[Pending Restart][Wild Felfire]All spells with a cast time against monsters reduce the cooldown of Chaos Bolt (Wild Felfire) by 1.5 seconds. This effect shares a cooldown with Emberstorm.

[Pending Restart][Wild Felfire]Wild Felfire now transforms your Chaos Bolt into Chaos Bolt (Wild Felfire). Dealing Chaos damage instead of Fire damage. Chaos damage is a combination of all spell schools and scales from the highest modifier to any school.
[Pending Restart][Booming Thunder] Booming Thunder buff now lasts 15 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Booming Thunder] New Effect: Consuming the effects of your Reverberation talent grants you stack of Booming Thunder and reduces the cooldown of your Elemental Blast by 2 seconds.
[Pending Restart][Booming Thunder] Elemental Blast hits now also give 4 stacks of Booming Thunder.
